text:
```yaml
name: Publish Skills

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install clawhub-cli

      - name: Authenticate with ClawHub
        run: echo ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }} | clawhub login --token -

      - name: Determine changed skills
        id: determine_changed_skills
        run: |
          CHANGED_SKILLS=$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD .skills/ skill.md | xargs -n 1 dirname | sort -u)
          echo "CHANGED_SKILLS=$CHANGED_SKILLS" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.inputs.force == true
        run: |
          for SKILL_DIR in $CHANGED_SKILLS; do
            clawhub publish $SKILL_DIR --accept-license-terms
          done

      - name: Re-publish all skills
        if: github.event.inputs.force == true
        run: clawhub publish --all --accept-license-terms
```
